issues.description: HC-2 declaration was stale/inconsistent with the implemented test: the MANIFEST still claimed the consumer test asserts the driver stdout returns a <def> element with device="Bee Focuser" carrying CONNECTION/ABS_FOCUS_POSITION/FOCUS_ABORT_MOTION, while test_indi_beefocus.py hc2_protocol_roundtrip() asserts only that the driver consumed the request (-v echo) and that the ELF carries the driver entry points plus INDI dispatch symbols.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update MANIFEST HC-2 description and the anti_hollow bullet to state exactly what is asserted.

issues.description: HC-4.5 assertion was effectively vacuous: it passed whenever the ELF simply had no RELRO program header, so a build without BIND_NOW/RELRO hardening could not fail it. HC-4.4 only checked that a 'Flags: 0x' line existed, not its value.
issues.fix_suggestion: Assert hardening deterministically (BIND_NOW present AND DF_1_PIE AND GNU_RELRO segment).

summary: W4 Pre-PR independent audit of indi-beefocus/0.1-20221222010828 on branch feat/indi-beefocus-0.1-20221222010828. Verdict PASS: no P0 (no hollow test, no forged status, no forged sha256) and no P1. 11-item evidence: (1) R34 - test_package/conanfile.py test() really executes the packaged binary via self.run(python3 test_indi_beefocus.py <pkg>/bin/indi_beefocus <pkg>/share/indi/indi_beefocus.xml) with env=conanrun, raising AssertionError when can_run() is false; the harness asserts on real artifacts (ELF64/EM_AARCH64/executable, upstream usage banner + exit-1 contract, nm symbol presence of 7 BeeFocused::Driver methods + 4 INDI dispatch symbols, well-formed share/indi/indi_beefocus.xml, DT_NEEDED without absolute paths). The HC-2 rework from a <def> round-trip to observable facts is HONEST, not a hollow dodge: the abandoned form is disclosed in notes.md and pr-body.md. (2) R39/PF7 - source URL is the salsa.debian.org official upstream-tag snapshot, NOT deb.debian.org; identical pattern to the in-repo libplayerone/3.1.0 precedent, so the 'upstream does not tag this subproject' justification is consistent and NOT mirror/fork evasion. (3) R8/PF5 - grep of patches/ for __OHOS__ returns 0 matches. (4) R26/R38 - package_type=application with software-level commands.json, artifacts bin/+share/+licenses only, no .so can shadow /lib or /lib64. (5) R32 - validate() uses self.settings.os not in (Linux, OHOS). (6) R33 - no bare ${CC}/${CFLAGS}/${CXX}/${LDFLAGS}. (7) R37 - version consistent across conanfile.py, both manifests, commands.json and the directory name. (8) R49/PF6 - no SYS_PREFIX//usr/local injection. (9) No hardcoded personal absolute paths. (10) conandata.yml sha256 well-formed 64-hex. (11) MANIFEST.yml upstream-test declaration sane (8 gtest, ctest, in_build true). The two non-blocking findings (1xP2, 1xP3) were fixed in the follow-up commit.
